full_track.tags: K-Pop indie folk with a shuffle rhythm. The arrangement features a prominent harmonica melody, acoustic guitar strumming in a swing feel, and a clean electric bass. A dry drum kit uses a brush-like snare sound on the backbeat. Male vocals are delivered in a conversational, mid-range baritone with light doubling in the chorus. The tempo is 105 BPM in the key of G Major. A bright harmonica provides melodic fills between vocal phrases. The acoustic guitar maintains a steady eighth-note shuffle pattern throughout.
